The weekly run also rebuilds the daily subjects, so it stores one complete warehouse in R2
(`warehouse/portfolio.duckdb.gz`, `warehouse/raw/`, `warehouse/features/`).

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › What the workflows add
items.text:
Each workflow checks out the repository, calls `.github/actions/data-setup` and then names
subjects. The shared setup checks the four R2 credentials, installs Python and
`platform/requirements.txt`, optionally the ML dependencies, and restores the stored raw files
(`pipeline.py pull`). All seven data workflows share the concurrency group `data-refresh`, so
two of them never write the same raw manifests or R2 keys at once. `queue: max` lets the runs
waiting for it start in order; by default GitHub keeps only the newest pending run and cancels
the others. Each workflow ends with an `alert` job (`.github/actions/failure-issue`): a failed or
timed-out run opens an issue labelled `data-pipeline-failure`, or comments on the open one, and
the next successful run closes it. A raw prune (`prune: true`) stops without deleting when more
than 5 % of a folder's stored files, or a folder without its local fetch log, would go;
`PRUNE_MAX_DELETE_PCT` raises the limit for an intentional cleanup.

What stays in YAML is the handling of failure, which differs per workflow:

- `refresh-jobs.yml` and `refresh-news.yml` call `.github/workflows/data-subject.yml` with

  their subjects and keep only their schedule and lock. The called job restores the subjects'

  raw files, builds and exports them, stores the raw files whatever the build did, and

  publishes only if every subject came through.

- `refresh-welfare.yml` runs welfare, parliament and taxes as three steps and pushes raw

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › What the workflows add
items.text:
checkpoints after each, so a timeout in one source does not lose what the others fetched.

  The group is published only if all three succeeded.

- `refresh-jobs.yml` stores the counts and the stream in R2 before it validates and

  publishes, so the next run starts from them even if validation fails.

- `refresh-news.yml` installs the optional summary SDK when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set. The

  subject tolerates exit code 2 from the summary step and publishes the headlines alone.

- `build-warehouse.yml` builds every subject, stores the warehouse only if all of them

  built, then exports and publishes each group whose subjects all came through. The quality

  subject ends with the structural gate, after the store. Last, `platform/publish/retention.py`

  plans the deletion of superseded releases, and deletes them only when the repository

  variable `RETENTION_APPLY` is `true` (docs/r2-delivery-contract.md).

- `publish-r2.yml` is the bootstrap: it stages every group and activates them together. It

  is not a subject and is run by hand.

- `cluster-jobs.yml` runs model fits and clustering sweeps that need more memory than a

  laptop, by hand and only from `main`. It is not a subject and publishes nothing. It pulls one

  features folder from the warehouse store, runs the chosen job (`futures-topics`, or `module`

  for `python -m <args>`) and pushes the folder back, after a failure too, so a stopped run

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › What the workflows add
items.text:
resumes from its checkpoints. Its lock is per job, not `data-refresh`; do not start it while

  `build-warehouse.yml` runs, since that run pushes back the copy of the features it pulled.

After a subject's ingest steps, successful or not, `pipeline.py` records the outcome in
`status/ingestion.json` (`platform/publish/ingest_status.py`): the error if any, the GitHub
run, and per raw source the last fetch, the last content change, files, size and this run's
fetches, changes and failed requests, read from `raw/<source>/_manifest.jsonl`. In Actions the
file is merged into an uncached copy in R2 outside every release; locally it is written to
`frontend/public/data/status/` (git-ignored). The projects page (`#projekt`) reads it. The sources
are the first segments of a subject's `raw` paths; a subject whose fetch log is kept outside
R2 lists it under `sources` (news).

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › What the workflows add
items.text:
Each subject declares `sla: {fresh_within: ...}` and, per layer it writes, the `write` mode its
code uses (header of `platform/pipeline.yml`; `platform/tests/architecture/test_pipeline_spec.py`
checks both against the code). Every hour `data-heartbeat.yml` (`platform/publish/heartbeat.py`)
reads the published `status/ingestion.json` and compares each subject's last successful ingestion
with its SLA: past it, one issue labelled `data-freshness` opens or is updated, and it closes
when all are fresh again. Only subjects with ingest steps are recorded, so only they are checked.
dbt source freshness on the fetch logs warns at the same age and never fails a run.

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › What a run refetches
items.text:
The daily runs restore the stored raw files first and fetch only what can have changed. The
rules are in `platform/lib/rawstore.py` and in each source's ingest script.

| Source | Every run | Reused until |
|---|---|---|
| SCB and Folkhälsomyndigheten (PxWeb) | Metadata, and periods from the last two calendar years | Older periods for 90 days, if URL, body, headers and hash match |
| OECD, Försäkringskassan's large tables | Försäkringskassan's metadata | Verified answers for 7 days, so current observations from these two can lag by up to a week |
| ESS | The portal's study and file versions | The same file version and variable selection for 90 days |
| Kolada | Metadata and the block that holds the current years | Complete older blocks for 90 days |
| Skatteverket and HUT | Municipal rates, current amounts, this year's withholding tables | Complete older years and HUT 2021 for 90 days |
| Riksdagen | The two latest sessions | Complete older sessions for 90 days |

A paged year or list is reused only when it has a completion record and every file it names
has the right hash. Starting an update removes the old completion record, so an interrupted
fetch never counts as complete history. `--full-refresh` ignores every age limit.

`refresh-welfare.yml` allows 240 minutes for the job, and 70, 90 and 60 minutes for welfare,
parliament and taxes.

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › ML stages
items.text:
Four subjects have one: ai_politics (similarity to the Act), symbolic, philosophy and concepts.
Each hashes what it is about to embed and records the hash in its `run.json`
(`platform/nlp/text/staleness.py`). With `--ml stale` the stage runs with `--if-stale` and does
nothing when the hash is unchanged. The scheduled weekly run uses `stale`; a run started by hand
defaults to `missing`.

A `run.json` written before the stages recorded a hash counts as stale, so the first `stale`
run recomputes ai_politics, philosophy and concepts once.

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › Still manual
items.text:
| What | Why |
|---|---|
| `platform/legacy/build_politics.py` | Needs three local sources (`--parliament`, `--allegoria`, `--local-corpus`); one is in no repository |
| `run legacy` (`npm run data:build`) | The builders not yet moved into dbt (`build_gold.py`, `build_products.py`, `build_speech_browser.py`); run when their inputs change |
| `run diva`, `run jobs_analysis` | Hours of harvesting or archive imports; started from the Actions tab |
| `symbolic:research`, `symbolic:clean`, `symbolic:experiments`, `symbolic:validity`, `symbolic:review` | Research steps that end in a human review of clusters |
| `politics:parties`, `politics:debates`, `data:parquet`, `data:upload` | Single scripts over local legacy outputs; `upload.py` is the unversioned uploader that preceded `release.py` |
| `publish-r2.yml` | First activation of a bucket, or a full re-stage |

`platform/ingest/jobtech/run_history_pipeline.py` keeps its own dbt build: it discovers which
archive years JobTech has published and passes them to dbt as vars. The registry calls it as
the jobs_analysis ingest step.

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › Secrets and variables
items.text:
All in the `anton-portfolio` environment, except where noted. The callers of
`data-subject.yml` (jobs and news) pass `secrets: inherit`: only the called job enters the environment, so the
caller cannot name its secrets. The called job hands `SCB_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` to
the build only when the caller asks for them (`scb-key`, `summary`).

| Workflow | Secrets | Variables |
|---|---|---|
| `refresh-welfare.yml`, `refresh-jobs.yml`, `refresh-diva.yml`, `refresh-job-analysis.yml`, `build-warehouse.yml`, `publish-r2.yml`, `cluster-jobs.yml` | `R2_ACCOUNT_ID`, `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` (or `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_ID`), `R2_BUCKET` | `R2_PUBLIC_BASE` |
| `refresh-news.yml` | the four above, and optionally `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | `R2_PUBLIC_BASE` |
| `ci.yml` | repository secrets `R2_ACCOUNT_ID`, `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `R2_BUCKET`, all optional | none |

`R2_PUBLIC_BASE` is `https://data.antonernstsson.com/`. Unset, the catalogue falls back to the
bucket's `r2.dev` address.

items.title: docs/pipeline.md › Adding a subject
items.text:
1. Add its entry to `platform/pipeline.yml`: steps in order, `group`, `schedule`, `sla`, `write`,
   and `raw` or `features` if it stores files in R2.
2. Give its files to a group in `configs/delivery/`, or leave them to `baseline`.
3. `python platform/pipeline.py run <subject> --dry-run`, then run it.

No workflow changes: the weekly run picks up every subject that is not marked `manual`.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2-audit.md › Political Observatory v2 audit and implementation record
docs/political-observatory-v2-audit.md › Architecture decisions
items.text:
- Five areas: Overview, Elections & Voters, Parliament & Governments, Economy & Policy,
  Debates & Legislation. One shared party selection and URL-addressed local filters.
- Retain detailed readers, tax tools, seat calculator, model and clustering as secondary views.
- Reuse published Parliament, Gold, debate and budget artifacts. Build compact contextual
  summaries before delivery; never send individual historical voting records to the browser.
- Prime minister ballots need separate official sources: ordinary committee roll calls do
  not contain them. Publish verified ballots from 2014 onward; disclose earlier coverage gaps.
- Separate a party's plurality, internal split, abstention, absence and unavailable data.
  Appointment succeeds with fewer than 175 no votes, regardless of affirmative votes.
- Government-period context uses dates of votes, not the government at a session's start.
  Agreements in the old seed lack precise intervals; do not infer support on individual dates.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2-audit.md › Dataset inventory
items.text:
| Artifact/model | Grain and coverage | Use and qualification |

| --- | --- | --- |

| `parliament/elections.json`, `fct_election` | Election x party, 1973 onward | Votes, share, allocated seats; NYD vote share unavailable separately in SCB |

| `parliament/polls.json`, `fct_party_poll` | SCB PSU survey month x party, 1972 onward | Survey estimates and supplied margins, distinct from elections |

| `parliament/now.json` | Dated election, government and recent-vote snapshot | Label snapshot dates; never imply a live feed |

| `parliament/sessions.json` | 33 sessions, party records and party pairs from 1993/94 | Historical substantive-vote similarity and activity |

| `parliament/issues.json`, `dim_issue` | 15 explicit committee/issue mappings | Issue joins to votes, expenditure areas and title-matched speech counts |

| `parquet/parliament_roll_calls` | Session x roll-call id | Substantive flag, date, committee and totals; compact export input |

| Gold `fact_party_vote` | Vote x party, delivered recent sessions | Individual party counts for contextual pairs and cohesion; bounded coverage |

| `seeds/parliament/governments.csv` | Government term from 1991 | Date context; seed agreement labels are term metadata, not dated support assertions |

| `gold/marts/budget-report.json` | Session x actor x expenditure area | Government and party proposals, adoption metadata, coverage; not spending outcomes |

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2-audit.md › Dataset inventory
items.text:
| `gold/tables/fact_budget_outturn.json` | Year x expenditure area, 1997 onward | Actual spending; historical area definitions need separate treatment |

| `taxes/countries.json` | Country x year x tax code | OECD tax share of GDP, country groups and historical comparisons |

| `politics/parliament/debate-stats` | Debate and session, 1993/94 onward | Speech/reply counts, committee-document relationships and lexical candidates |

| `parliament/studies.json` | Study, bill and cited studies | Explicit preparation-section citations; document links do not establish causation |

| Political decision shards and Gold evidence marts | Vote/decision point/document | Vote distributions, sources, reservations, bills and speech candidates |

| Political topic/UMAP exports | Speech chunk/model/session | Existing experiments retained with their sample/model metadata |

No local DuckDB warehouse is present. Existing published Parquet and JSON provide a
reproducible offline build input. Source data is retained.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2-audit.md › Implementation and validation
items.text:
The five-area workspace is implemented. The retired four-tab `report/Report.tsx`, its unused
chart composition and CSS were removed; underlying data and detailed research views remain.
The shared time-series chart gained optional line breaks and a fixed upper bound. Isolated
survey intervals use whiskers. The homepage does not import this chart.

New source-backed seeds hold ten ballots and 83 party records. New Gold models cover ballot
facts, contextual party pairs and contextual cohesion. The offline export contains 22,680
substantive roll calls in 33 session shards, 840 pair/context groups, 240 cohesion/context
groups, 537 decision-coverage groups, 246 party/session speech summaries and nine government
terms. Full warehouse export uses tested historical party facts; offline detailed context
is explicitly limited to 2024/25?2025/26.

[Political Observatory v2](political-observatory-v2.md) specifies the routes, source coverage,
measure denominators, evidence boundaries, release ownership and reproduction commands.

Checks performed:

- TypeScript and the production build pass. Prettier passes. This repository has no ESLint

  dependency or configured lint command; no ESLint run is claimed.

- JavaScript unit suite: 104 passed, including weighted similarity, distinct cohesion

  denominators, context URLs, null contexts and missing-observation line segments.

- Python suite: 461 passed, two skipped. New tests exercise the real context SQL and the

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2-audit.md › Implementation and validation
items.text:
offline calculation on hand-worked votes, government-date boundaries, join uniqueness,

  missing/tied/all-absent positions and the committed contract.

- Formation dbt build: two seeds, two models and eight tests passed. The official-source

  verifier validated all ten documents. Existing unrelated dbt deprecation warnings remain.

- Initial full browser regression: 140 passed, two opt-in live tests skipped; one route test

  needed its obsolete report-class selector updated. The affected 22-test rerun passed,

  including the complete internal-link traversal, five-area desktop/mobile axe scans,

  readers, filters, decision links, historical government context and provenance download.

- Five desktop and mobile pages were opened and captured with Chromium. Mobile comparison

  labels and bars were inspected and corrected. Dense matrices scroll locally; no page

  overflow was observed. Final complete browser regression: **142 passed, two opt-in live tests skipped**.

  The complete Python rerun passed **461 tests, with two skipped**. Build, TypeScript,

  Prettier and all 104 JavaScript unit tests passed. Logs: `artifacts/politics-v2/final-*.log`.

- All 15 protected source hashes match the task-start baseline: homepage files, App,

  shared header, tokens and editorial styles are byte-identical. Existing changes from

  the earlier design-system task were preserved.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2-audit.md › Implementation and validation
items.text:
Known limits: pre-2014 appointment ballots are not digitized here; later selected ballots
are not claimed exhaustive. Detailed offline party context spans two sessions. Agreement
labels lack complete dated support intervals. Legacy semantic speech candidates and
bill/study links have bounded source coverage. No complete historical warehouse rebuild,
live R2 publication or production deployment was performed. Existing experimental debate
maps are retained; no additional small-sample party embedding was introduced.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Political Observatory v2

dataset inventory and keep/improve/consolidate decisions for the previous visualizations.

items.text:
`PoliticsProduct.tsx` keeps the existing research views and readers. The former four-tab

`#politik-valjarna`, `#politik-roster`, `#politik-budget-detalj`, `#politik-skatter`,

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Filter contracts
items.text:
- `partier` follows navigation between areas and retained research views. In ordinary
  decision details it highlights parties without dropping votes whose party records are absent.
- `fran`/`till` identify survey/election calendar years, or parliamentary session **start
  years** on parliamentary pages. Survey dates are not inferred from sessions or governments.
- `riksmote`, `omrade`, `regering` filter compatible parliamentary counts. Government joins
  use `start_date <= vote_date < end_date`. The decision-session choices use actual
  government/issue coverage, including sessions containing a change of government.
- `par` selects a party pair; `rost` selects a decision. `statsrost`, `kandidat`,
  `statsfran`, `statstill` belong to the appointment matrix and have independent period controls.
- Budget `ar`/`aktor`, survey `osakerhet`, debate `ledardebatt`/`amnesgrund`, and experimental
  `experiment` are local. Area navigation drops unrelated local state while retaining context.
- Coverage-series charts explicitly state which filters apply. The reply matrix has its own
  debate selector. Survey and budget observations are never filtered by incompatible vote keys.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Published data and build
items.text:
The new contract is `parliament/workspace/index.json`: schema version, export date, input
SHA-256 values, government terms, appointment ballots, contextual pairs, cohesion counts,
decision coverage and per-party/session speech activity. Historical session
and party-pair marts supply pre-aggregated counts for the browser.

`parliament/workspace/decisions/<session>.json` is fetched only for the selected session.
The committed snapshot has 33 shards and 22,680 substantive roll calls; the largest shard is
under 1 MB uncompressed. Totals that do not cover all 349 seats are flagged, not repaired.

```powershell
python platform/ingest/riksdagen/formation_ingest.py
python platform/publish/politics_workspace.py --as-of 2026-10-16
npm run check
npm run build
```

The standalone exporter works offline from existing JSON/Parquet. Its committed contextual
coverage is **2024/25–2025/26**: 840 pair/context groups and 240 party/context groups.
`export_parliament.py` passes its tested warehouse connection to the same exporter after
writing the parliamentary contracts; this uses all available `gold.fct_party_roll_call`
counts. `decision_coverage` comes from dated votes, not session-start government labels.

New dbt models:

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Published data and build
items.text:
| Model | Grain |
| --- | --- |
| `fct_prime_minister_ballot` | Official ballot date/key |
| `fct_prime_minister_party_vote` | Ballot × party, with original source label |
| `mart_party_pair_context` | Session × vote-date government × issue × unordered party pair |
| `mart_party_cohesion_context` | Session × vote-date government × issue × party |

The parliamentary pipeline verifies the curated sources before dbt. Seed keys, relationships,
categories, counts and the rejection rule have dbt tests. Context SQL and offline aggregation
are checked with hand-worked fixtures. Delivery ownership is `public-data`; the baseline
spec excludes `parliament/workspace/*`. New artifacts must enter an approved release before
production use. The frontend retains the existing manifest pinning and integrity checks.
No release was published or deployed during this task.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Appointment coverage and provenance
items.text:
The matrix contains ten reviewed records from **2 October 2014 to 15 October 2026**, including
the 2018 incumbent check. It excludes no-confidence motions. Earlier ballots are absent and
coverage after 2022 is not claimed exhaustive. The
[Riksdag archive](https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/sa-fungerar-riksdagen/demokrati/sa-bildas-regeringen/tidigare-regeringsbildningar-och-statsministrar/)
and official protocols/news provide the sources. Each CSV record carries a URL, SHA-256,
extraction method and qualification. The verifier downloads/cache-checks official documents
and compares text-PDF tables with reviewed seeds. Scanned 2022 and HTML records are manually
curated against their linked sources; source changes require a documented review.

Rejection requires **at least 175 no votes**, not 175 affirmative votes. Approval and subsequent
installation are separate: the 24 November 2021 proposal was approved but the proposed S+MP
government did not take office. Recorded historical mistakes in a member's vote are not corrected
to presumed intentions. FP is canonical L, with its original label retained; independents remain
separate in detailed counts.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Appointment coverage and provenance
items.text:
Matrix cells distinguish yes, no, abstain, all-absent, mixed present positions, explicit
non-representation and unavailable records. Missing rows are never interpreted as abstention
or proof that a party was unrepresented. A party with both present and absent members retains
its present vote category; the exact absent count remains available in the drill-down.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Measures and relationships
items.text:
- Similarity: same unique plurality position / comparable substantive roll calls. Yes, no

  and abstain are distinct comparable positions. Ties, all-absent and missing party records

  are excluded pairwise. Counts pool across contexts before division; percentages are not

  averaged. The heatmap and pair trend use a 0–100% scale. Similarity is not ideological distance.

- Cohesion: plurality-aligned cast member-votes / cast member-votes on roll calls with a

  unique plurality. **Participation:** present / eligible member-votes, with abstention counted

  as present. Mixed roll calls are counted separately, including tied splits.

- PM-party alignment: equal yes/no pluralities / comparable yes/no roll calls, matching the

  PM's historical party. This is a recorded party position, not an independently measured

  official government preference. Abstention is excluded from this measure.

- Budget difference: party proposal minus government proposal for the same budget year

  and expenditure area, displayed in SEK billion. Actual outturn is separate, nominal and

  not inflation-adjusted. Missing proposals are absent, not zero.

- Debate topics: selected-party utterances weighted equally across each debate's assigned

  issues / all selected utterances in the session. Unassigned/excluded utterances stay in the

  denominator. The default uses committee/report-title matches; lexical candidates require

  an explicit toggle. Neither is a confirmed procedural or causal link.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Measures and relationships
items.text:
- Decision evidence: exact session/vote key → unique decision point → explicitly cited

  bill; bills' preparation citations → studies where the delivered recent-bill register has

  coverage. Ambiguous multiple-point vote links are not expanded into inflated counts.

  Semantic speech candidates retain their experimental label and similarity value.

- Policy navigation: `dim_issue` maps committees to issues and expenditure areas. It makes

  related votes, budgets and debates reachable without asserting equivalence between their measures.

items.title: docs/political-observatory-v2.md › Limits and verification
items.text:
The government seed starts in 1991. Its agreement names describe term metadata, sometimes
only part of a term; the workspace does not infer dated support or opposition from them.
Election allocation is labelled separately from subsequent membership changes. The government
snapshot is dated 28 September 2026 and retains its recorded caretaker status; it is not a live feed.
Budget years and expenditure classifications have documented gaps. Semantic speech retrieval
and bill/study evidence cover only their existing delivered subsets.

Existing debate embeddings/maps remain optional experiments. No additional eight-party UMAP,
forecast, semantic join presented as fact, or paid infrastructure was added.

Verification results and file protection checks are recorded in the audit's implementation
section. Visual evidence is under `artifacts/politics-v2/`; it includes the five desktop/mobile
pages and the official scanned 2022 ballot table. Full historical warehouse ingestion was not
rerun: the local checkout had no full warehouse. The targeted formation dbt build and real
context SQL on fixtures were run, alongside the existing data and frontend suites.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Klustring av partiledardebatter och länsprofiler
items.text:
Experiment 2026-10-12. [Metod, datakvalitet och återkörning](public-clustering-method.md)
innehåller källhashar, modellrevisioner, hela parameterutrymmet och kommandon.
Det underliggande Riksdagslagret saknas lokalt; den befintliga publicerade
fulltextkorpusen har frysts utan ny ingestion. Ingen data har publicerats.
Endast öppen, publicerad data skickas till Workers AI. Besökarens text loggas aldrig och sparas inte.

Debatterna omfattar 108 debatter och 10 148 hämtade anföranden från 1993-2026.
Efter parti-/längdkrav används 26 592 icke överlappande passager från 9 986
anföranden. Separat texttvätt tar bort Word-fält och återförenar avstavningar,
med oförändrade id:n och originalen bevarade. Kvarvarande fältfragment och
rengöringsheuristik redovisas i metodrapporten. Representativa, slumpade och
slumpade bruspassager sparas med spårbarhet till debatt, talare, parti och datum.

Länsprofilen använder sju numeriska årsindikatorer från Kolada under 2024,
alla 21 län och inga saknade värden. Månadstal, flerårsestimat och upprepad
länshistorik ingår inte. Grupperna gäller liknande indikatorprofiler, inte
hur bra regionerna mår. Skala, dtype (float32), observations-id och ML-kod
är frysta före modelljämförelserna.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Uppföljning 2026-10-14: konsensus över tolv seeds

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Varianter
items.text:
passagerna utan grupp mot 16 % för SBERT. På filosofin är modellen sämre på alla mått.

- Att ta bort de sju grupper som saknade namn och klustra om gav inte bättre grupper.

  Med svensk stoppordslista visade sig fyra av dem vara ämnen: EU och euron, brott

  och polis, arbetsmarknadspolitik, skattesänkningar och budget.

- Passager om cirka 300 ord gav filosofin lika många grupper men fler passager utan

  grupp och split-half-ARI under gränsen.

- `bge-m3` kördes 2026-10-14 genom Cloudflare Workers AI (`platform/nlp/workers_ai.py`)

  med samma inställningar som SBERT och en egen valnyckel (`pick-debate-bge-m3.json`), så

  att den inte tävlar om kartan. Den lämnar 28,8 % utan grupp mot 16,2 %, har

  split-half-ARI 0,735 under gränsen 0,75 och poäng −0,014 mot 0,171. Den är alltså

  klart sämre för kartan.

- Demon "Var hamnar din mening?" behåller därför SBERT-kartan, dess grupper och namn.

  Besökarens mening bäddas in med bge-m3, och punkten placeras bland de närmaste

  passagerna i bge-m3 med deras koordinater på SBERT-kartan. Sökningen sker i

  webbläsaren på PCA-komprimerade int8-vektorer. Med 384 dimensioner hittar den 94,1 %

  av de tio närmaste passagerna enligt cosinus på de fulla vektorerna (500 slumpade

  passager som frågor). Med 256 dimensioner blir andelen 86,0 %.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Namn och intrångstest
items.text:
31 av 33 debattgrupper har namn och rymmer 73,5 % av passagerna. Två grupper med
10,3 % har inget namn. 21 grupper delar minst 85 % av sina passager med en grupp som
fick namn 2026-10-13 och behöll det namnet. Tio fick namn efter läsning av åtta
slumpade passager var. I filosofin har 17 av 19 grupper namn (64,4 % av passagerna).

Intrångstestet visar fyra passager ur en grupp och en ur en annan, två uppgifter per
grupp. Läsaren pekade ut rätt passage i 52 av 66 uppgifter för debatterna (79 %) och
25 av 38 för filosofin (66 %). Slumpen ger 20 %. Noll rätt av två fick
skattesänkningar och budget, försvar och skogen bland debatterna, skönhet och konst
samt skrift och tro i filosofin. Läsaren var samma språkmodell som satte namnen och
hade redan läst passager ur 11 debattgrupper och 7 filosofigrupper. Testet är därför
inte oberoende, och en mänsklig läsare återstår.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Två nivåer
items.text:
Grupper med minst 800 passager klustrades en gång till med åtta seeds. Delningen
visas när split-half-ARI når 0,75. Åtta av 13 debattgrupper delas, till exempel EU i
samarbete (1 101 passager), euron (535) och folkomröstning (178), och brott och polis
i polis och straff (1 055), alkohol (79) och abort (54). I filosofin delas en av fem
grupper. Delgrupperna har bara de vanligaste orden som etikett; ingen har läst dem.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Kommuner
items.text:
280 kommuner 2024 med tolv indikatorer. Till de sju tidigare kom folkmängd
(logaritmerad), in- och utpendling, försörjningskvot och andel med eftergymnasial
utbildning från Kolada. PCA behåller fyra komponenter (40,2, 24,0, 11,7 och 6,1 % av
variansen).

Gap-regeln väljer k=2 (71 och 209 kommuner): silhouette 0,352 mot 0,201 för omkastade
kolumner, bootstrap-ARI 0,75. Med sju indikatorer var silhouette 0,327 mot 0,253.
Sidan visar den finare delningen k=4, som har högst bootstrap-ARI (0,77) och
silhouette 0,274 mot 0,201.

| Grupp | Kommuner | Kännetecken |
|---|---|---|
| Förorter med hög inkomst och pendling | 33 | medianinkomst 470 452 kr, utpendling 70,8 % |
| Mindre orter med stabil sysselsättning | 111 | arbetslöshet 2,1 %, sysselsättning 84,6 % |
| Större städer | 40 | arbetslöshet 3,4 %, eftergymnasial utbildning 45,7 % |
| Landsbygd med svagare arbetsmarknad | 96 | ohälsotal 31,0 dagar, bistånd 3,4 % |

AMI mot SKR:s kommungrupper är 0,319 för k=4 och 0,172 för k=2, mot 0,138 med sju
indikatorer. Grupperna följer nu kommuntyp mer än förut, vilket är väntat när
folkmängd och pendling ingår. Silhouette 0,27 betyder att grupperna överlappar.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Debatter
items.text:
Texten rensades från tilltal till talmannen, applådnoteringar, instämmandelistor och
procedurrader och delades vid meningsslut i passager om 80 till 150 ord. Det ger
33 023 passager ur 9 976 anföranden i 108 debatter.

Sökningen prövade 288 passningar med KBLab:s svenska SBERT. Vald körning
`1b8a9e8a84859c4437eb93f1`: vektorerna centrerade per talare, UMAP 5D med 30 grannar
och `min_dist` 0, HDBSCAN `eom` med `min_cluster_size` 150, `min_samples` 25 och
storlekstak 10 %. Centrering per talare höjde DBCV från 0,345 till 0,441 på första
seeden. Över tre seeds ger körningen 32, 33 och 31 grupper med seed-ARI 0,77 med brus
som egen grupp och 0,96 bland passager som fick grupp i båda körningarna.

Två grupper med centroidlikhet över 0,7 slogs ihop (klimat och grön skatteväxling).
4 385 bruspassager återfördes till närmaste grupp. På 4 801 gömda gruppassager
hamnade 93 % av de återförda i rätt grupp. Riktigt brus är svårare än gömda passager,
så talet är en övre gräns.

25 grupper fick namn efter läsning av 5 till 13 slumpade passager per grupp. De
rymmer 55,7 % av passagerna. Sju grupper med 30,3 % av passagerna har inget namn:
där delade passagerna inget ämne, de är repliker och allmän debattretorik. 14,0 % har
ingen grupp.

Utan storlekstak gav samma inställning en grupp på 66 % på två av tre seeds.
Sökningen på en seed såg inte det, så finalisterna körs alltid med taket.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Filosofi
items.text:
100 verk från Project Gutenberg lades till Atlasens 13, sammanlagt 113 verk av 66
författare i 20 traditioner, högst 200 passager per verk. Den publicerade Atlasen
(`corpus.json`) är oförändrad. De nya verken ligger i `corpus_extended.json`.

576 passningar med två modeller. Utan centrering följer grupperna författaren: AMI
mot författare 0,48 som högst. Centrerat per verk sjunker det till 0,078 i vald
körning `374061f1cc0b8a61bc9712d3` (paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, UMAP 5D
med 30 grannar, HDBSCAN `eom` 120 och 25). Varje grupp spänner över minst 70 verk.

Seed-ARI är 0,64 med brus som egen grupp och 0,88 bland tilldelade passager. Gränsen
0,75 nås inte. Kärnan lämnar 52,5 % som brus och DBCV är 0,25 på första seeden.
Grupperna är alltså glesare och mindre stabila än debatternas, och kartan ska läsas
som en rimlig indelning bland flera. 13 av 17 grupper fick namn och rymmer 62,0 % av
passagerna.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Kommuner och län
items.text:
280 kommuner 2024 med sju indikatorer. Tio kommuner ingår inte: sju saknar värde för
ekonomiskt bistånd och tre för valdeltagande. StandardScaler, PCA med tre komponenter (51,8, 20,0 och
9,7 % av variansen) och K-means. Gap-statistiken valde k=3 bland lösningar med
bootstrap-ARI minst 0,75.

| Grupp | Kommuner | Kännetecken |
|---|---|---|
| Hög inkomst | 43 | medianinkomst 460 777 kr, ohälsotal 17,5 dagar |
| Stabil sysselsättning | 128 | nära medel på inkomst, låg arbetslöshet |
| Högre arbetslöshet och bistånd | 109 | arbetslöshet 3,1 %, bistånd 3,4 % |

Silhouette 0,327 mot 0,253 för omkastade kolumner (95:e percentilen, 200 omgångar).
Bootstrap-ARI 0,82. AMI mot SKR:s kommungrupper är 0,138: grupperna följer
välfärdsutfall och inte kommuntyp. Silhouette runt 0,33 betyder att grupperna
överlappar. De är en sammanfattning av en gradient och inga skilda kommunslag.

Länen klustras inte längre. 21 observationer gav grupper som ändrades när ett län
eller en indikator togs bort. Rapporten visar länen efter två principalkomponenter
(40,1 och 35,0 % av variansen) med indikatorernas riktning.

items.title: docs/public-clustering-experiments.md › Resultat och tolkning
items.text:
Grundsökningens 261 parameterpunkter och ytterligare 90 leaf-punkter är genomförda.
Det ger 351 unika passningar på fullt observationsunderlag, varav sex återanvända
länspiloter. Därtill finns sex mindre textpiloter, nio debatturvalskontroller,
21 lämna-ett-län-ut-kontroller och sju indikatorablationer: 394 sparade körningar.
Det frysta huvudregistret har inga misslyckade klustringskörningar.

Följande är granskningskandidater vid seed 42, valda per representation efter
originalrymdens silhuett, minst två grupper, högst 70 % brus och högst 80 % i en
grupp. Urvalet är geometriskt och efterhandsvalt; det fastställer inte semantisk
träffsäkerhet. Fullständig söktabell finns lokalt i `sweep.csv`.

Alla tre debattkandidater använder UMAP 10D, `min_dist=0.2`, HDBSCAN
`min_cluster_size=100`, `min_samples=10`, leaf. TF-IDF och svensk SBERT använder
60 grannar; MiniLM 15. Länens UMAP-kandidat använder 3D, 3 grannar,
