items.title: fct_sfs_document (platform/models/gold/sfs/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model fct_sfs_document, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/sfs/fct_sfs_document.sql.
One row per document in Riksdagen's SFS list (int_sfs_documents) with its numbered paragraphs and passages from int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs. Read by platform/publish/export_sfs.py for the statute-book page.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

items.title: fct_sfs_document (platform/models/gold/sfs/schema.yml)
items.text:
Columns:
- dok_id: Key: Riksdagen's document id, unique where the SFS number is not.
- kind: Attribute: lag, förordning or other, from the first word of the title; grundlagar and Riksdagsordningen count as lag.
- issued_year: Attribute: year of issued.
- is_repealed: The repeal date is on or before the fetch date; false when there is none.
- repealed_year: The year of repeal, for repealed documents only.
- sections: Distinct numbered paragraphs (chapter and §).
- paragraph_passages: Paragraph rows in int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs; a long § gives one per stycke.
- whole_text_passages: Whole-text passages, for a document with no numbered paragraph.
- sfs: Attribute: SFS number (beteckning), such as 2010:800; not unique.
- title: Attribute: title of the document, whitespace collapsed.
- issued: Attribute: date of issue from Riksdagen's list; null when unparsable.
- repealed_on: Attribute: repeal date from the text header (Upphävd); null when none or no text.
- has_text: Attribute: true when the document's text was fetched.
- parse_status: Attribute: parsed, unnumbered (no numbered §), failed (numbered § but none split out) or no text.
- text_chars: Measure, additive: characters in the fetched text; null when there is no text.
- fetched_at: Attribute: time the text was fetched; null when there is no text.

items.title: fct_sfs_document (platform/models/gold/sfs/schema.yml)
items.text: Tests: accepted_values on kind (lag, förordning, other); not_null on dok_id; not_null on is_repealed; not_null on issued_year; not_null on kind; not_null on paragraph_passages; not_null on sections; not_null on whole_text_passages; unique on dok_id.

items.text:
Model fct_sfs_passage, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/sfs/fct_sfs_passage.sql.
One row per passage in int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs with its length, without the text. Read by platform/publish/export_sfs.py for the passage length bands.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- id: Key: dok_id plus riksdagen.se's anchor K<chapter>P<§>S<stycke>, or dok_id-whole[-n] for a whole-text passage.
- kind: paragraph, or whole_text for a document with no numbered paragraph.
- text_chars: Characters in the passage text.
- dok_id: Attribute: the passage's document; references fct_sfs_document.

Tests: not_null on id; not_null on kind; not_null on text_chars; unique on id.

items.text:
Model fct_sick_leave_cases, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/welfare/fct_sick_leave_cases.sql.
Started and ongoing sick-leave cases (Försäkringskassan). F43 is inside F00-F99; never add them.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- case_type: Key: started (new cases in the month) or ongoing (cases open at month end).
- region_code: Key, references dim_region: 00 the country or a two-digit county.
- period_key: Key, references dim_period: month, YYYY-MM.
- sex_key: Key, references dim_sex: T total, K women, M men.
- age_group_key: Key, references dim_age_group: ALL for started cases; FK age bands for ongoing cases, 16+ their total.
- diagnosis_code: Key, references dim_diagnosis: ALL, an ICD-10 chapter as FK groups it, or F43 (inside F00-F99, never add them).
- period_start: Attribute: first day of the month; ISO date.
- cases: Measure, additive: count of sick-leave cases; started is a flow, ongoing a stock (do not add over months); NULL when suppressed.
- cases_suppressed: Attribute: true when Försäkringskassan suppressed the count; cases is then NULL, not zero.
- yoy_change_pct: Measure, non-additive: FK's change against the same month a year earlier; per cent; started cases only, NULL for ongoing.

Columns:
- sick_pay_rate: Sickness benefit rate: paid sick days per insured person per year, not a per cent.
- region_code: Key, references dim_region: 00 the country, two-digit county or four-digit municipality.
- period_key: Key, references dim_period: month, YYYY-MM; the rate covers the twelve months to it.
- sex_key: Key, references dim_sex: T total, K women, M men.

- insured_persons_suppressed: Attribute: true when Försäkringskassan suppressed insured_persons.

items.title: fct_social_survey_country (platform/models/gold/welfare/schema.yml)
items.text:
Columns:
- indicator_key: Key, references dim_indicator: ess_<variable>, an ESS item from seeds ess_variables.
- country_code: Key, references dim_country: ESS two-letter country code.
- period_key: Key, references dim_period: ESS round, ESSn.
- sex_key: Key, references dim_sex: T total, K women, M men.
- age_group_key: Key, references dim_age_group: 15+ total, or 15-29, 30-44, 45-64, 65+.
- survey_mode: Attribute: interview or self_completion; ESS10 moved some countries to self-completion.
- respondents: Measure, additive: respondents with a valid answer to the item; count of respondents.
- effective_n: Measure, non-additive: Kish effective sample size from the weights, used for the interval.
- mean_value: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean answer on the item's scale (see dim_indicator.unit), weighted by pspwght.
- ci_low: Measure, non-additive: mean minus 1.96 standard errors from effective_n; ignores the design, so too narrow.
- ci_high: Measure, non-additive: mean plus 1.96 standard errors from effective_n; ignores the design, so too narrow.
- share_high_pct: Measure, non-additive: weighted share at or beyond the item's threshold (for example 7-10 on 0-10); per cent 0-100.

items.text:
Model fct_tax_wedge, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/taxes/fct_tax_wedge.sql.
Labour taxation per country, year, household type and wage level (OECD Taxing Wages).
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- country_code: Key, references dim_tax_country: ISO 3166 alpha-3 country code or OECD/EU aggregate code.

- year: Key: calendar year.

- household_type: Key: OECD Taxing Wages household type code (single or couple, with or without children).

- wage_level: Key: OECD code for the principal earner's wage as a share of the average wage, e.g.

AW100.

- spouse_wage_level: Key: OECD code for the spouse's wage level; _Z or NOEARN_UNEMP when there is no earning spouse.

- tax_wedge_pct: Measure, non-additive: average tax wedge, income tax plus employee and employer contributions less cash benefits over labour cost; per cent.

- marginal_tax_wedge_pct: Measure, non-additive: marginal tax wedge on a rise in the principal earner's gross earnings; per cent.

- income_tax_pct: Measure, non-additive: average income tax rate (OECD AV_ITR); per cent.

- employee_ssc_pct: Measure, non-additive: average employee social security contribution rate (OECD AV_R_EMPEE_SSC); per cent.

- employer_ssc_pct: Measure, non-additive: average employer social security contribution rate (OECD AV_R_EMPER_SSC); per cent.

items.title: fct_tax_wedge (platform/models/gold/taxes/schema.yml)
items.text:
- net_personal_average_rate_pct: Measure, non-additive: net personal average tax rate, income tax and employee contributions less cash benefits over gross earnings; per cent.

- gross_earnings_usd_ppp: Measure, non-additive: household gross earnings before taxes, a level per household; USD at purchasing power parity.

- net_income_usd_ppp: Measure, non-additive: household net income after taxes and benefits, a level per household; USD at purchasing power parity.

- labour_cost_usd_ppp: Measure, non-additive: gross labour cost (earnings plus employer contributions), a level per household; USD at purchasing power parity.

- gross_earnings_national: Measure, non-additive: household gross earnings before taxes, a level per household; national currency.

Tests: unique_combination of country_code, year, household_type, wage_level, spouse_wage_level.

The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:

- session_year_start: Attribute: first day of session_year, ISO date; the time dimension.
- session_year: Attribute: calendar year the session starts in.
- topic_label: Attribute: topic label from its top terms, in Swedish.
- segments: Measure, additive: count of the party's speech segments assigned to the topic in the session.
- words: Measure, additive: count of words in those segments.
- word_share_pct: Measure, non-additive: topic's share of the party's words in the session, per cent 0-100; adds to 100 over topics within one model, session and party.
- file_order: Attribute: position of the row in delivery order (legacy model first, then files in path order, then rows in file order).

One row per paragraph (§) of every fetched SFS document, or per stycke of one longer than 1,500 characters, split as int_sfs_paragraphs is, plus whole-text passages of at most 1,500 characters for each fetched document with no numbered paragraph (the XML texts left out). Paragraph rows are not split further. No embeddings.

Columns:
- id: <dok_id>-[K<chapter>]P<§>[S<stycke>], e.g. sfs-1962-700-K3P1 or sfs-1959-287-P2S5; <dok_id>-whole for a whole text that fits in one passage, else <dok_id>-whole-<n> from 1.
- kind: paragraph, or whole_text for a document with no numbered paragraph.
- dok_id
- text

Tests: accepted_values on kind (paragraph, whole_text); assert_sfs_whole_text_only_without_paragraphs; not_null on dok_id; not_null on id; not_null on kind; not_null on text; relationships on dok_id to int_sfs_documents.dok_id; unique on id.

Tests: accepted_values on kind (lag, förordning, other); accepted_values on parse_status (parsed, unnumbered, failed, no text); assert_sfs_catalogue_fetched; not_null on dok_id; not_null on kind; not_null on parse_status; not_null on sfs; not_null on title; relationships on dok_id to int_sfs_documents.dok_id; unique on dok_id.

items.title: mart_ai_act_changes (platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ai_act_changes, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/mart_ai_act_changes.sql.
Documents, guidance and article-level changes, each with its official source.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- change_id: Key: 'doc:<celex>', 'guidance:<guidance_id>' or 'provision:<provision_id>:<amending celex or unmarked>'.

- change_date: Attribute: ISO date of the change: the document's or guidance page's publication date; for provisions, the amending act's date or the current version's.

- change_kind: Attribute: amendment, corrigendum, consolidated_version, proposal, implementing_act, commission_report, guidance or provision.

- source_url: Attribute: URL of the official source: EUR-Lex for documents and provisions, the Commission page for guidance.

- document_id: Attribute: CELEX number of the document (dim_ai_act_document), or guidance_id for guidance rows; for provisions, the amending act or the current version.

- document_title: Attribute: title of the document or guidance page; 'Consolidated text' for provision rows with no named amending act.

- article_number: Attribute: number of the changed article; null for annexes and for document and guidance rows.

- provision_id: Attribute: ELI provision id of the changed article or annex; null for document and guidance rows.

- provision_title: Attribute: English title of the changed provision; null for document and guidance rows.

items.title: mart_ai_act_changes (platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/schema.yml)
items.text:
- change_type: Attribute: how the provision changed: inserted, deleted, amended or text_differs; null for document and guidance rows.

- affected_actors: Attribute: semicolon-separated actor_ids the changed article puts under a 'shall' (derived); null when none or not an article row.

- basis: Attribute: where the row comes from: 'Cellar', 'Commission page' or the comparison of the Official Journal text with the consolidated text.

Tests: assert_ai_act_sources_are_official; not_null on change_date; not_null on change_id; not_null on change_kind; not_null on source_url; unique on change_id.

items.title: mart_ai_act_obligations (platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ai_act_obligations, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/mart_ai_act_obligations.sql.
Actor × obligation × article with the verbatim sentence, our classification and a plain-language summary.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- obligation_id: Key: id of the curated obligation, e.g.

'lit-provider' (seeds/eu_ai_act/ai_act_obligations.csv).

- actor_id: Foreign key to dim_ai_act_actor: the actor the obligation falls on.

- article_number: Foreign key to dim_ai_act_article: the article the obligation is written in.

- source_quote: Attribute: the sentence of the Act the obligation rests on, verbatim.

- applies_from: Attribute: ISO date from which the article applies, from its Article 113 rule.

- source_url: Attribute: EUR-Lex URL of the current consolidated text, anchored at the article.

- actor_official_term: Attribute: the actor's term as the Act writes it in English.

- actor_label_en: Attribute: the actor's display label in English.

- actor_label_sv: Attribute: the actor's display label in Swedish.

- requirement_type: Attribute: our classification of what is required, e.g.

ai_literacy, prohibition, risk_management, transparency (curated).

- risk_class_id: Foreign key to dim_ai_act_risk_class: the risk class the obligation belongs to (curated).

- risk_class_en: Attribute: the risk class's name in English.

items.title: mart_ai_act_obligations (platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/schema.yml)
items.text:
- risk_class_sv: Attribute: the risk class's name in Swedish.

- paragraph: Attribute: paragraph number within the article; null when the obligation is not tied to one paragraph.

- article_title_en: Attribute: the article's title in English.

- article_title_sv: Attribute: the article's title in Swedish.

- chapter: Attribute: chapter of the article, a Roman numeral.

- section: Attribute: section of the article within its chapter; null when there is none.

- summary_en: Attribute: short English explanation written for this site, not legal text.

- summary_sv: Attribute: short Swedish explanation written for this site, not legal text.

- applies_from_second: Attribute: ISO date from which the remaining parts of the article apply; null when the whole article applies from applies_from.

- applies_partially: Attribute: true when parts of the article apply from applies_from_second.

- application_quote: Attribute: the sentence of Article 113 the application date rests on, verbatim.

- article_change_type: Attribute: how the article differs from the Official Journal text: inserted, amended, text_differs or unchanged.

- quote_type: Attribute: content kind of source_quote, always 'source'.

- classification_type: Attribute: content kind of actor, risk class and requirement type, always 'interpretation'.

- summary_type: Attribute: content kind of the summaries, always 'interpretation'.

items.title: mart_ai_act_obligations (platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/schema.yml)
items.text: Tests: assert_ai_act_sources_are_official; not_null on actor_id; not_null on applies_from; not_null on article_number; not_null on obligation_id; not_null on source_quote; not_null on source_url; relationships on actor_id to dim_ai_act_actor.actor_id; relationships on article_number to dim_ai_act_article.article_number; unique on obligation_id.

items.title: mart_ai_act_speech_similarity (platform/models/gold/ai_politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ai_act_speech_similarity, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/ai_politics/mart_ai_act_speech_similarity.sql.
Per AI Act article, the closest Riksdag AI paragraphs by multilingual embeddings (semantic similarity, derived).
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- similarity: Measure, non-additive: cosine similarity between the paragraph and the article's best-matching passage, -1 to 1.

- model: One model for both sides; a test checks there is only one.

- speech_url: Attribute: link to the speech on data.riksdagen.se.

- speech_id: Foreign key to fct_ai_speech: the speech the paragraph comes from.

- article_number: Key: AI Act article number, from the current Swedish version.

- rank: Key: 1 for the speech paragraph closest to the article, then 2, 3 and so on.

- above_chance: Attribute: true when similarity is above chance_p95, the 95th percentile of random speech-Act pairs.

- chance_p95: Measure, non-additive: 95th percentile cosine similarity of 5,000 random speech-Act pairs in the same run; one value for all rows.

- act_passage_id: Attribute: id of the article's best-matching passage, art_<article number>:<0-based passage index>.

- act_passage_sv: Attribute: text of that AI Act passage, in Swedish.

- paragraph: Attribute: 0-based index of the paragraph within the speech text.

- speech_paragraph: Attribute: text of the speech paragraph, in Swedish.

items.title: mart_ai_act_speech_similarity (platform/models/gold/ai_politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
- speech_date: Attribute: date of the speech, ISO date.

- party: Attribute: the speaker's party code; null for speakers without a party.

- speaker: Attribute: the speaker's name and title as in Riksdagen's export.

- debate_title: Attribute: title of the debate item the speech belongs to.

- act_version: Attribute: CELEX number of the AI Act version the passages come from.

- content_type: Attribute: always 'derived'; the pairs are computed by embeddings.

Tests: assert_one_embedding_model; between on similarity from -1 to 1; not_null on model; not_null on similarity; not_null on speech_url; relationships on speech_id to fct_ai_speech.speech_id; unique_combination of article_number, rank.

items.title: mart_ai_act_term_diffusion (platform/models/gold/cross_domain/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ai_act_term_diffusion, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/cross_domain/mart_ai_act_term_diffusion.sql.
Corpus × term list × term × language × month of the AI Act's own terms in Riksdag speeches and job ads, whole months only (derived; never pooled across corpora).
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- corpus: Key: riksdag (speeches) or job_ads (ads).
- term_list: Key: primary (the pre-registered terms and matching) or amended (the 2026-10-22 amendment: re-reviewed terms, every token inflected).
- term_id: Key: the term (seeds/cross_domain/ai_act_terms.csv, decision or amended_decision keep).
- language: Key: sv for the Swedish term, en for its reviewed English counterpart.
- term: Attribute: the term as matched.
- month: Key: calendar month, as the date of its first day; only whole months of the corpus.
- matches: Measure, additive within a corpus: documents that contain the term in the month.
- documents: Measure, additive within a corpus: all speeches or ads in the month; 0 in a month without sittings.
- share: matches / documents, null when documents is 0. Fraction from 0 to 1.
- share_rolling_3m: Measure, non-additive: matches over documents summed over this and the two preceding months; fraction 0-1.
- content_type: Attribute: content kind of the row, always 'derived'.

items.title: mart_ai_act_term_diffusion (platform/models/gold/cross_domain/schema.yml)
items.text: Tests: accepted_values on corpus (riksdag, job_ads); accepted_values on language (sv, en); accepted_values on term_list (primary, amended); assert_diffusion_matches_within_documents; between on share from 0 to 1; between on share_rolling_3m from 0 to 1; not_null on corpus; not_null on documents; not_null on language; not_null on matches; not_null on month; not_null on term_id; not_null on term_list; relationships on term_id to ai_act_terms.term_id; unique_combination of corpus, term_list, term_id, language, month.

items.title: mart_ai_act_timeline (platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ai_act_timeline, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/mart_ai_act_timeline.sql.
Application dates and deadlines from the Act and the dates of the documents that made it.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- milestone_id: Key: id of the milestone, curated (e.g.

'entry-into-force') or 'document-<celex>' for document dates.

- date: Attribute: ISO date of the milestone.

- source_url: Attribute: EUR-Lex URL: the current consolidated text at source_article, or the document itself for document rows.

- kind: Attribute: entry_into_force, application or deadline (curated from the Act), or document (from Cellar).

- title_en: Attribute: short title in English.

- title_sv: Attribute: short title in Swedish.

- description_en: Attribute: English description written for this site; for document rows, the document's title.

- description_sv: Attribute: Swedish description written for this site; for document rows, the document's title untranslated.

- affected_articles: Attribute: semicolon-separated article numbers the milestone concerns; null for document rows.

- affected_actors: Attribute: semicolon-separated actor_ids the milestone concerns; null for document rows or when none are named.

- source_article: Attribute: number of the article the milestone rests on (113, 111 or 6); null for document rows.

items.title: mart_ai_act_timeline (platform/models/gold/eu_ai_act/schema.yml)
items.text:
- source_quote: Attribute: the sentence of that article, verbatim; null for document rows.

- origin: Attribute: where the row comes from: 'curated from the Act' or 'Cellar'.

- status_at_build: Attribute: 'applies' when date is on or before built_on, else 'upcoming'; the site recomputes it for the reader's date.

- built_on: Attribute: ISO date the warehouse was built, the reference for status_at_build.

Tests: assert_ai_act_dates_valid; assert_ai_act_sources_are_official; not_null on date; not_null on milestone_id; not_null on source_url; unique on milestone_id.

items.title: mart_ai_governance_timeline (platform/models/gold/cross_domain/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ai_governance_timeline, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/cross_domain/mart_ai_governance_timeline.sql.
Month × series of AI in the Riksdag and in job ads, for one timeline with the AI Act's milestones (derived; temporal overlap only).
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- series_id: Key: the series, one of riksdag_ai, riksdag_ai_act, jobs_ai_any, jobs_ai_act, jobs_ai_governance (seeds/cross_domain/ai_governance_series.csv).
- share: numerator / denominator. Fraction from 0 to 1, not per cent.
- share_rolling_3m: Measure, non-additive: sum of numerator over sum of denominator for this and the two preceding rows of the series; fraction 0-1.
- domain: Attribute: source domain of the series, politics or jobs.
- month: Key: calendar month, as the date of its first day.
- numerator: Measure, additive: Riksdag speeches or job ads matching the series in the month; count of speeches or ads. Never add across series.
- denominator: Measure, additive: all Riksdag speeches or all job ads in the month; count of speeches or ads.
- source_model: Attribute: the gold model the counts come from, mart_ai_politics_monthly or mart_job_ai_governance_terms.
- content_type: Attribute: content kind of the row, always 'derived'.

items.title: mart_ai_governance_timeline (platform/models/gold/cross_domain/schema.yml)

items.title: mart_ai_politics_framing (platform/models/gold/ai_politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ai_politics_framing, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/ai_politics/mart_ai_politics_framing.sql.
Framing pairs per party and phase, with a balance only from ten speeches.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- party: Key: party code, or 'ALL' for every speaker including those without a party.
- balance: Measure, non-additive: (speeches_a - speeches_b) / (speeches_a + speeches_b), -1 (only B) to 1 (only A); null below ten speeches using either.

- period: Key: a phase (before_proposal, negotiation, after_publication) or 'all'.
- period_kind: Attribute: what period holds: phase or all.
- speeches_a: Measure, additive: count of AI speeches with the pair's concept A in an AI paragraph.
- speeches_b: Measure, additive: count of AI speeches with the pair's concept B in an AI paragraph.
- speeches_both: Measure, additive: count of AI speeches with both concepts.
- ai_speeches: Measure, additive: count of speeches mentioning AI for the party and period.

items.text:
Model mart_ai_politics_monthly, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/ai_politics/mart_ai_politics_monthly.sql.
Month × all speeches, AI speeches and AI Act speeches, shares and a three-month rolling share.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- month: Key: first day of the calendar month.
- ai_share: AI speeches / all speeches in the month. Fraction from 0 to 1, not per cent.
- speeches: Measure, additive: count of Riksdag speeches in the month.
- ai_speeches: Measure, additive: count of speeches in the month that mention AI.
- ai_act_speeches: Measure, additive: count of speeches in the month that name the AI Act.

- speeches_rolling_3m: Measure, non-additive: count of speeches in this and the two preceding months (a rolling window, so rows overlap).

items.title: mart_analysis_confounders (platform/models/gold/quality/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_analysis_confounders, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/quality/mart_analysis_confounders.sql.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- remaining_risk: Attribute: the risk that remains after mitigation, a person's interpretation; never null.
- analysis: Key: id of the analysis the confounder threatens, the same id as analysis_id in mart_analysis_validity.
- confounder: Key: short label for the confounder, for example the symbol word itself.
- diagnostic: Attribute: plain-text name of the diagnostic or experiment that looks for the confounder.
- effect: Attribute: what the confounder does to the result, as stated in the validity registry.
- mitigation: Attribute: what was done to reduce the confounder's effect.
- content_type: Attribute: always 'interpretation'; every text in the row is a person's judgement, not a computed value.

Tests: not_null on remaining_risk; unique_combination of analysis, confounder.

items.title: mart_analysis_validity (platform/models/gold/quality/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_analysis_validity, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/quality/mart_analysis_validity.sql.
One analytical validity diagnostic per row.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- product_id: Foreign key to dim_quality_product: the product the analysis belongs to.

- status: Attribute: the diagnostic's status: supported, warning, insufficient_evidence, invalidated or not_evaluated.

- kind: Attribute: validity kind, one of construct_validity, confounding, representativeness or ml_data_quality.

- interpretation: Attribute: a person's interpretation of the diagnostic, in English; never null.

- analysis_id: Key: analysis id from platform/quality/validity_registry.yml.

- analysis_order: Attribute: 0-based position of the analysis in the validity registry, for display order.

- diagnostic_order: Attribute: 0-based position of the diagnostic within its analysis, for display order.

- question_en: Attribute: the question the analysis answers, in English.

- question_sv: Attribute: the question the analysis answers, in Swedish; null when not translated.

- target_construct: Attribute: the construct the analysis is meant to measure.

- proxy_measure: Attribute: what the analysis actually measures in place of the construct.

- diagnostic_id: Key: diagnostic id, unique within its analysis.

- diagnostic: Attribute: English label of the diagnostic; the diagnostic id when no label is registered.

items.title: mart_analysis_validity (platform/models/gold/quality/schema.yml)
items.text:
- experiment: Attribute: the pipeline experiment the diagnostic reads, for example baseline; null when not tied to one.

- result: Measure, non-additive: the diagnostic's computed value, unit set by the diagnostic; null for qualitative diagnostics or a missing artefact.

- details: Attribute: JSON with the inputs behind result, or the error when its artefact could not be read.

- rule: Attribute: JSON rule turning result into status (metric_below or metric_above with then and otherwise); JSON null for qualitative diagnostics.

- analysis_status: Attribute: the analysis's weakest diagnostic status, repeated on each of its rows.

- conclusion_en: Attribute: the analysis's overall conclusion in English, repeated on each of its rows.

- conclusion_sv: Attribute: the analysis's overall conclusion in Swedish; null when not translated.

- source: Attribute: the file or artefact the analysis rests on, for example platform/ingest/symbolic/corpus.json; null when not registered.

- evaluated_at: Attribute: UTC time of the platform/quality/evaluate.py run that produced the row.

- result_content_type: Attribute: always 'derived'; result is computed from the pipelines' artefacts.

- interpretation_content_type: Attribute: always 'interpretation'; interpretation and conclusions are a person's judgement.

items.title: mart_analysis_validity (platform/models/gold/quality/schema.yml)
items.text: Tests: accepted_values on kind (construct_validity, confounding, representativeness, ml_data_quality); accepted_values on status (supported, warning, insufficient_evidence, invalidated, not_evaluated); not_null on interpretation; relationships on product_id to dim_quality_product.product_id; unique_combination of analysis_id, diagnostic_id.

items.title: mart_budget_context (platform/models/gold/politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_budget_context, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/politics/mart_budget_context.sql.
One row per budget year: governing and agreement parties, the adopted proposal, the completeness of imported expenditure frames, and the exact FiU1 point 2 roll call. Delivered as gold/marts/budget-context.json by platform/publish/export_politics.py, which also reconciles it byte for byte against the committed delivery.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- budget_year: Key: calendar year the budget applies to, 2015-2026.

- session: Key, references dim_parliament_session: riksmöte, e.g.

2024/25.

- decision_document: The session's FiU1 report; the parsed comparison table, else the first candidate tried.

- adopted: Attribute: which proposal the Riksdag adopted, government_proposal or alternative.

- frame_status: Attribute: completeness of the government frame: complete (27 areas), partial, or not_imported.

- government_parties: Attribute: list of party codes in government when the budget was decided.

- agreement_parties: Attribute: list of party codes with a budget agreement with the government; empty when none.

- agreement_source_url: Attribute: source for the budget agreement; null when there was no agreement.

- comparison_source_url: Attribute: Riksdagen document URL of the session's FiU1 report (decision_document).

items.title: mart_budget_context (platform/models/gold/politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
- adopted_parties: Attribute: list of party codes behind the adopted proposal; government plus agreement parties, or the alternative's parties.

- adoption_source_url: Attribute: source for the adopted proposal; the alternative's source, else the FiU1 report URL.

- frame_rows: Attribute: struct of imported budget-frame row counts per proposer (GOV and each party); 27 is a full frame, 0 not imported.

- decision_point: Foreign key to mart_vote_decisions: point_id of FiU1 point 2 in the session; null when that point is not imported.

- decision_date: Attribute: decision date of FiU1 point 2, ISO date; null when the point is not imported.

- vote_id: Attribute: Riksdagen roll-call id for FiU1 point 2; null when no roll call is imported.

- party_votes: Attribute: list of structs per party: modal position and counts of yes, no, abstain and absent members in the FiU1 point 2 roll call; empty when not imported.

- cited_documents: Attribute: list of structs for documents the point explicitly cites: reference, type, url, link evidence; citation is not party support.

- reservations: Attribute: list of party codes that entered a reservation against the point; empty when none or not imported.

- related_speeches: Attribute: list of structs with each party's most similar speech to the roll call; semantic discovery candidates, not stances.

items.title: mart_budget_context (platform/models/gold/politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
- link_quality: Attribute: struct stating the evidence level of each link (budget to decision, decision to vote, speech to vote, citation to point).

Tests: accepted_values on adopted (government_proposal, alternative); accepted_values on frame_status (complete, partial, not_imported); assert_budget_votes_complete; not_null on budget_year; not_null on decision_document; not_null on session; relationships on session to dim_parliament_session.session; unique on budget_year; unique on session.

items.title: mart_budget_language_gap (platform/models/gold/politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_budget_language_gap, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/politics/mart_budget_language_gap.sql.
Exact-key join of the corrected party frame and the language audit, only for party proposals that cover all 27 expenditure areas. Delivered as gold/tables/mart_budget_language_gap.json, where attention_minus_budget_pp is formed. Descriptive difference; speeches may come after the budget proposal.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

items.title: mart_budget_language_gap (platform/models/gold/politics/schema.yml)
items.text:
Columns:
- corpus: Key: speech archive the audit read, leaders (party-leader debates) or issues (issue debates).
- method: Key: keyword matching method, exact (token equals a keyword) or stem (Swedish Snowball stem equals a keyword's stem).
- session: Key, references dim_parliament_session: riksmöte, e.g. 2024/25.
- party: Key, references dim_party: party code (C, KD, L, M, MP, S, SD, V).
- expenditure_area: Key: expenditure area (utgiftsområde) number, 1-27.
- budget_year_start: Attribute: first day of budget_year, ISO date; the time dimension.
- budget_year: Attribute: calendar year the party's budget proposal applies to.
- amount_msek: Measure, additive: party's proposed frame for the area; million SEK.
- budget_share_pct: Measure, non-additive: area's share of the party's whole frame, per cent 0-100; adds to 100 over areas.
- keyword_occurrences: Measure, additive: count of keyword occurrences for the area in the party's speeches (fct_language_area.occurrences).
- keyword_share_pct: Measure, non-additive: area's share of the party's keyword matches, per cent 0-100; null when the party has no matches.
- attention_minus_budget: Measure, non-additive: keyword_share_pct minus budget_share_pct, percentage points; descriptive, not a stance; adds over areas within one party and session.
- source_url: Attribute: source URL of the party's budget proposal row.
- file_order: Attribute: position of the row in the language audit file (fct_language_area.file_order).

items.title: mart_budget_language_gap (platform/models/gold/politics/schema.yml)
items.text: Tests: relationships on party to dim_party.party; unique_combination of corpus, method, session, party, expenditure_area.

items.title: mart_concept_passages (platform/models/gold/concepts/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_concept_passages, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/concepts/mart_concept_passages.sql.
Representative chunks per concept and corpus, with provenance.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- representative_rank: Key: rank of the chunk by z-score among the corpus's chunks where the concept is in the top three; 1 to 8.

- concept_id: Key, references dim_concept: the concept the passage is representative for.

- corpus_id: Key, references dim_corpus: the corpus the passage comes from.

- similarity: Measure, non-additive: cosine similarity of the chunk to the concept's anchor sentence in the chunk's language; -1 to 1.

- rank: Measure, non-additive: the concept's rank among all 28 concepts for this chunk; 1 to 3 here.

- z_score: Measure, non-additive: similarity standardised against the same concept in the same corpus; standard deviations.

- chunk_id: Foreign key to dim_text_chunk: the representative chunk.

- language: Attribute: language of the chunk text, en or sv.

- document_id: Attribute: id of the source document: book, philosophy work, Riksdag speech or AI Act provision.

- document_title: Attribute: readable title of the source document.

- location: Attribute: where in the document the chunk sits, e.g.

passage number or paragraph of the speech.

- source_url: Attribute: URL of the source the chunk was read from.

items.title: mart_concept_passages (platform/models/gold/concepts/schema.yml)
items.text:
- source_version: Attribute: hash of the source version the chunk was read from.

- retrieved_at: Attribute: when the source was retrieved; ISO 8601 UTC text.

- period: Attribute: speech date for Riksdag chunks; ISO date text, null for the other corpora.

- text: Attribute: the chunk text as it stands in the source.

- content_type: Attribute: content type of the row, always 'derived'.

Tests: assert_concept_passages_in_chunk_text; between on representative_rank from 1 to 8; unique_combination of concept_id, corpus_id, representative_rank.

items.title: mart_concept_profiles (platform/models/gold/concepts/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_concept_profiles, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/concepts/mart_concept_profiles.sql.
Concept × corpus rank-1 and top-3 shares against chance (derived).
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- rank1_share: Measure, non-additive: rank1_chunks / chunks; share 0-1.
- corpus_id: Key, references dim_corpus: the corpus.
- concept_id: Key, references dim_concept: the concept.
- chunks: Measure, additive: count of the corpus's chunks scored against the concept.
- rank1_chunks: Measure, additive: count of chunks where the concept is the closest of all concepts (rank 1).
- top3_chunks: Measure, additive: count of chunks where the concept is among the three closest concepts.
- top3_share: Measure, non-additive: top3_chunks / chunks; share 0-1.
- rank1_chance: Measure, non-additive: rank-1 share expected by chance, 1 / number of concepts; share 0-1.
- rank1_lift: Measure, non-additive: rank1_share / rank1_chance; ratio, 1 means chance level.
- content_type: Attribute: content type of the row, always 'derived'.

Tests: between on rank1_share from 0 to 1; unique_combination of corpus_id, concept_id.

items.title: mart_concept_relations (platform/models/gold/concepts/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_concept_relations, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/concepts/mart_concept_relations.sql.

The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:

- concept_b: Key, references dim_concept: the alphabetically second concept of the pair.
- strength: Measure, non-additive: mean of English and Swedish anchor cosine similarity for semantic_similarity; null for shared_tension.
- tension_id: Foreign key to dim_tension: the Philosophy Atlas tension the pair are poles of; null for semantic_similarity.
- content_type: Attribute: content type: 'derived' for semantic_similarity, 'interpretation' for shared_tension.

Tests: accepted_values on relation_type (semantic_similarity, shared_tension); assert_concept_tensions_exist; relationships on concept_a to dim_concept.concept_id; relationships on concept_b to dim_concept.concept_id; unique_combination of concept_a, concept_b, relation_type.

items.title: mart_county_year_panel (platform/models/gold/welfare/serving/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_county_year_panel, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/welfare/serving/mart_county_year_panel.sql.
Counties and the country by calendar year, one column per measure, each aggregated by its rule. For regression, correlation and maps. Carries numerators and denominators (unemployed and labour force, sick-pay days and insured) so regions combine correctly. County-level associations describe counties, not individuals.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- fohm_hard_to_trust_pct: Folkhälsomyndigheten: finds it hard to trust others, 16-84, per cent, pooled.

- fohm_good_health_pct: Folkhälsomyndigheten: good or very good self-rated health, 16-84, per cent, pooled.

- fohm_good_wellbeing_pct: Folkhälsomyndigheten: good mental wellbeing, 16-84, per cent, pooled.

- fohm_serious_mental_strain_pct: Folkhälsomyndigheten: serious mental strain, 16-84, per cent, pooled over fohm_period.

- eligible_vocational_programme_pct: Kolada N15428: year-9 pupils eligible for vocational upper-secondary programmes, per cent.

- low_trust_pct: Kolada U01413: inhabitants 16-84 lacking trust in others, per cent.

- good_wellbeing_pct: Kolada U01473: inhabitants 16-84 with good mental wellbeing, per cent.

- serious_mental_strain_pct: Kolada N01452: inhabitants 16-84 with serious mental strain, per cent (FoHM survey via Kolada).

items.title: mart_county_year_panel (platform/models/gold/welfare/serving/schema.yml)
items.text:
- turnout_riksdag_pct: Kolada N05403: turnout in the latest Riksdag election, per cent (changes in election years).

- violent_crime_per_100k: Kolada N07403: reported violent crime per 100,000 inhabitants (where the crime happened).

- social_assistance_pct: Kolada N31807: inhabitants receiving social assistance during the year, per cent.

- median_earned_income_sek: Kolada N00906: median earned income 20-64, SEK.

A median: never average across regions.

- ill_health_days: Kolada N00957: ohälsotal, days.

- sick_pay_rate_1_days: Kolada N00938: sjukpenningtal 1.0, 16-64, days per registered insured.

- employment_rate_20_64_pct: Kolada N02267: employment rate 20-64 (register based).

- open_unemployment_18_65_pct: Kolada N03937: openly unemployed, share of population 18-65 (Arbetsförmedlingen register, not AKU).

- ongoing_sick_leave_per_1000: ongoing_sick_leave_mean per 1,000 inhabitants (all ages).

- stress_cases_per_1000: stress_cases_started per 1,000 inhabitants (all ages).

- insured_persons: Denominator of sick_pay_rate_days: persons insured for sick pay in December.

- sick_pay_days: Numerator of sick_pay_rate_days (rate x insured); sum over regions, then divide.

- labour_force_thousands: AKU labour force (employed + unemployed), thousands; denominator for combining regions.

- unemployed_thousands: AKU unemployed, thousands; numerator for combining regions.

- employment_rate_pct: AKU employment rate, 15-74, per cent of the population, published annual figure.

items.title: mart_county_year_panel (platform/models/gold/welfare/serving/schema.yml)
items.text:
- unemployment_rate_moe: 95% margin of error of unemployment_rate_pct, percentage points.

- population_is_perturbed: True for years published under SCB's cell key method (small per-cell noise).

- population: SCB population on 31 December (stock: add counties, never years).

- year: Calendar year.

- is_country: True for the country row (00); exclude it when aggregating counties.

- region_code: SCB region code: 00 the country, two digits a county.

- year_start: 1 January of the year; the semantic layer's time dimension.

- nuts2_code: NUTS2 area (riksområde) of the county.

- region_name: Region name.

- unemployment_rate_pct: AKU, 15-74, SCB's published annual rate; margin in unemployment_rate_moe.

- sick_pay_rate_days: FK sjukpenningtal 2.0 in December (a rolling twelve-month measure), from 2021.

- stress_cases_started: Started F43 cases in the year; NULL unless all twelve months are published.

- ongoing_sick_leave_mean: Mean of the twelve month-end stocks of ongoing cases (16+); a stock is never summed.

- fohm_period: The four-year span the fohm_* columns pool; they sit in the span's last year.

Tests: not_null on region_code; relationships on region_code to dim_region.region_code; unique_combination of region_code, year.

items.title: mart_ess_country_round (platform/models/gold/welfare/serving/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_ess_country_round, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/welfare/serving/mart_ess_country_round.sql.
ESS weighted means per country and round, plus pooled NORDIC and EU27 groups computed from respondents with the analysis weight. Compare rounds within a country only with survey_mode in view (ESS10 self-completion).
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- unit_type: Attribute: country for a single country, group for a pooled NORDIC or EU27 row.

- unit_code: Key: ESS two-letter country code (as in dim_country), or NORDIC or EU27 for a group.

- period_key: Key, references dim_period: ESS round, ESSn.

- survey_mode: Attribute: interview or self_completion for a country row; NULL for group rows.

- countries_in_unit: Attribute: comma-separated country codes that took part in the round for this unit.

- respondents: Measure, non-additive: distinct respondents with at least one valid answer; count of respondents; groups overlap countries.

- ppltrst_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of ppltrst (most people can be trusted, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- trstprl_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of trstprl (trust in parliament, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- trstplt_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of trstplt (trust in politicians, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

items.title: mart_ess_country_round (platform/models/gold/welfare/serving/schema.yml)
items.text:
- trstplc_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of trstplc (trust in the police, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- trstlgl_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of trstlgl (trust in the legal system, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- stflife_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of stflife (satisfaction with life, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- happy_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of happy (how happy, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- stfdem_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of stfdem (satisfaction with democracy, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- stfeco_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of stfeco (satisfaction with the economy, 0-10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- health_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of health (subjective general health, 1 very good to 5 very bad); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- sclmeet_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of sclmeet (meets friends and relatives, 1 never to 7 every day); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

- imwbcnt_mean: Measure, non-additive: weighted mean of imwbcnt (immigrants make the country worse 0 or better 10); pspwght for countries, analysis weight for groups.

Tests: unique_combination of unit_code, period_key.

items.title: mart_job_ai_governance_terms (platform/models/gold/job_ai_governance/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_job_ai_governance_terms, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/job_ai_governance/mart_job_ai_governance_terms.sql.
Month × term × occupation field with denominators, rolling share and year-on-year change.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- share: Mentions of the term / ads. Fraction from 0 to 1, not per cent.
- ads: Measure, additive: count of ads published in the month and field, summed over archives; the denominator of share.
- term_id: Key: term id from seeds/job_ai_governance/job_ai_governance_terms.csv.
- month: Key: first day of the ads' publication month.
- field_id: Key, references dim_market_field: JobTech occupation-field id; 'ALL' for the whole market; null for ads without a field.
- field: Attribute: occupation field label; 'All occupation fields' for ALL.
- mention_count: Measure, additive: count of ads whose headline or description matches the term; 0 when none.
- share_rolling_3m: Measure, non-additive: mention_count / ads summed over this and the two preceding months of the series; fraction 0-1.
- share_change_yoy_pp: Measure, non-additive: share minus share 12 rows earlier in the field and term series, on the 0-1 scale (0.01 = 1 pp); null for the first 12 months.

Tests: between on share from 0 to 1; not_null on ads; not_null on share; relationships on term_id to job_ai_governance_terms.term_id; unique_combination of month, field_id, term_id.

- occupation_group: Attribute: occupation group label (Swedish), from its latest month.
- field_id: Foreign key to dim_market_field: the group's occupation field in its latest month.
- field: Attribute: the group's occupation field label in its latest month.

- vacancies: Measure, additive: positions sought; an ad without a valid number of vacancies counts as one.

- months: Measure, non-additive: distinct count of months with ads for the group in the year.
- ads_ytd_previous_year: Measure, additive: ads_ytd of the group's previous row (normally the year before); NULL for its first year.

The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- variant: Key: map variant: baseline (embeddings as they are) or author_centered (each work's mean vector removed).
- passage_id: Key: passage identifier, document_id and zero-based passage index.
- document_id: Foreign key to dim_philosophy_document: the work the passage comes from.
- author: Attribute: author of the work.
- title: Attribute: title of the work.
- tradition: Attribute: philosophical tradition of the work.
- period: Attribute: period of the work.
- year: Attribute: approximate year of the work; negative means BCE.
- translator: Attribute: translator of the work; null when the file names none.
- position: Attribute: zero-based index of the passage within the work's own text.
- text: Attribute: passage text, verbatim from the cleaned work.
- x: Attribute: horizontal map coordinate from 2-D UMAP; unitless.
- y: Attribute: vertical map coordinate from 2-D UMAP; unitless.
- cluster_id: Attribute: HDBSCAN cluster number within the variant; -1 is noise. Numbered, never named.
- probability: Measure, non-additive: HDBSCAN membership probability for the passage's cluster; 0-1, 0 for noise.
- is_noise: Attribute: true when cluster_id is -1.

items.title: mart_philosophy_clusters (platform/models/gold/philosophy/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_philosophy_clusters, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/philosophy/mart_philosophy_clusters.sql.

The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

items.title: mart_philosophy_clusters (platform/models/gold/philosophy/schema.yml)
items.text:
Columns:
- review_status: Attribute: review status: unreviewed unless a person reviewed the fingerprint (candidate, reviewed, rejected).
- largest_work_share: Measure, non-additive: passages from the cluster's largest work / size; share 0-1.
- variant: Key: map variant: baseline or author_centered.
- cluster_id: Key: HDBSCAN cluster number within the variant; noise is not a row.
- size: Measure, additive: count of passages in the cluster.
- fingerprint: Attribute: first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the cluster's sorted passage ids; identity across runs.
- works: Attribute: JSON object of document_id to passage count, most common first.
- traditions: Attribute: JSON object of tradition to passage count, most common first.
- work_count: Measure, non-additive: distinct count of works with passages in the cluster.
- work_entropy: Measure, non-additive: entropy of passages over all sampled works, normalised; 0 (one work) to 1 (even).
- is_cross_work: Attribute: true when the cluster has at least three works and none above half of it.
- representatives: Attribute: JSON list of passage ids nearest the cluster centre.
- distinctive_terms: Attribute: JSON list of the cluster's most distinctive words by class-based TF-IDF; not a label.
- review_label: Attribute: label written by a person reviewing the cluster; null while unreviewed, never generated.
- content_type: Attribute: content type of the row, always 'derived'.

items.title: mart_philosophy_clusters (platform/models/gold/philosophy/schema.yml)
items.text: Tests: accepted_values on review_status (unreviewed, candidate, reviewed, rejected); between on largest_work_share from 0 to 1; unique_combination of variant, cluster_id.

items.title: mart_quality_checks (platform/models/gold/quality/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_quality_checks, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/quality/mart_quality_checks.sql.
One data-quality check result per row.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- quality_check_id: Key: check id from platform/quality/quality_registry.yml.

- product_id: Foreign key to dim_quality_product: the product the check belongs to.

- dimension: Attribute: ISO/IEC 25012 dimension id: accuracy, completeness, consistency, credibility, currentness or traceability.

- status: Attribute: pass, warning, fail, not_measured or not_applicable; a check that measured nothing is not_measured.

- severity: Attribute: how much a failure matters: info, warning or error; separate from status.

- method: Attribute: how the check is measured: dbt_test, python, manual_review, not_measured or not_applicable.

- project_id: Attribute: the product's project id on the site, for example symbolic-atlas.

- dataset_id: Attribute: the table, file or artefact the check is about, for example silver.int_symbol_occurrences.

- dimension_label: Attribute: English label of the dimension.

- description: Attribute: what the requirement says, in plain language.

- measure_name: Attribute: name of the measure behind value; null for checks without a numeric measure.

- numerator_definition: Attribute: what the numerator counts; null when the check has no numerator.

items.title: mart_quality_checks (platform/models/gold/quality/schema.yml)
items.text:
- denominator_definition: Attribute: what the denominator counts; null when the check has no denominator.

- comparator: Attribute: how value is compared with threshold: >=, <= or ==; null when the check has no threshold.

- threshold: Attribute: the pass level for value, in value's unit; null for not_measured and not_applicable checks.

- warn_at: Attribute: the edge between warning and fail, in value's unit; null when the check has no warning band.

- value: Measure, non-additive: the measured value, unit set by the measure (share 0-1 for dbt and manual-review checks); null when nothing was measured.

- numerator: Measure, non-additive: numerator of value (for example passing tests or valid sampled rows); not comparable across checks; null when not measured.

- denominator: Measure, non-additive: denominator of value (for example tests that ran or rows reviewed); not comparable across checks; null when not measured.

- sample_size: Measure, non-additive: count of rows in a manual review sample; null for checks that are not manual reviews or have no review.

- reviewed_at: Attribute: date of the manual review as recorded in the registry (text); null without a review.

- source: Attribute: what the check is checked against, as stated in the registry.

- gate: Attribute: true when a failure of this structural check fails CI.

- details: Attribute: JSON with the evidence: failed and not-run tests, review notes, the reason nothing was measured, or an error.

items.title: mart_quality_checks (platform/models/gold/quality/schema.yml)
items.text:
- evaluated_at: Attribute: UTC time of the platform/quality/evaluate.py run that produced the row.

- content_type: Attribute: always 'derived'; values are computed, definitions live in the registry.

Tests: accepted_values on dimension (accuracy, completeness, consistency, credibility, currentness, traceability); accepted_values on method (dbt_test, python, manual_review, not_measured, not_applicable); accepted_values on severity (info, warning, error); accepted_values on status (pass, warning, fail, not_measured, not_applicable); assert_not_measured_has_no_value; not_null on quality_check_id; not_null on status; relationships on product_id to dim_quality_product.product_id; unique on quality_check_id.

The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- year: Key: calendar year of the speech or publication year of the thesis.
- corpus: Key: 'riksdag' or 'diva'; never pooled.
- cluster: Key: cluster number of the run; -1 is noise.
- label: Dimension: 'unreviewed cluster N' until reviewed, 'noise' for -1.
- top_terms: Dimension: the cluster's ten c-TF-IDF terms, future marker words removed.
- stable: Dimension: the run passed the stability and null criteria and the cluster's Jaccard match is at least 0.5 in every seed.
- sentences: Measure, additive: sampled sentences in the cluster.
- year_sentences: Measure: sampled sentences of the year and corpus, noise included; the denominator.
- share: Non-additive ratio: sentences / year_sentences.
- share_low: Non-additive: 2.5th percentile of 1,000 multinomial bootstrap shares.
- share_high: Non-additive: 97.5th percentile of 1,000 multinomial bootstrap shares.
- run_id: Dimension: the clustering run.

Tests: accepted_values on corpus (riksdag, diva); between on share from 0 to 1; not_null on cluster; not_null on year; unique_combination of year, corpus, cluster.

items.text:
Columns:
- domain_id: Every subject must be classified; a new SCB subject fails this test.
- geo_resolution: Attribute: finest geography by the region codes reported: national, county, municipality or subarea; Kolada county or municipality.
- last_year: SCB only; Kolada's catalogue has no period range.

- catalogue: Key: source catalogue: scb or kolada.

- subject_label: Attribute: SCB second-level subject label, or Kolada's operating area.
- frequency: Attribute: publication frequency: month, quarter or year (other SCB time units lower-cased); Kolada always year.
- first_year: Attribute: year of the SCB table's first period; NULL for Kolada, whose catalogue has no period range.
- updated_at: Attribute: when SCB last updated the table; NULL for Kolada.
- measures: Measure, additive: contents (metric categories) in the SCB table's metadata; NULL for Kolada and for SCB tables without a region variable, whose metadata is not fetched.

items.title: mart_symbol_atlas (platform/models/gold/symbolic/schema.yml)
items.text:
Model mart_symbol_atlas, gold layer, materialized as table, defined in platform/models/gold/symbolic/mart_symbol_atlas.sql.
One point per sampled symbol occurrence with its map position, cluster and context.
The contract is enforced: dbt checks the column names and types at build time.

Columns:
- occurrence_id: Key: occurrence identifier, first 16 hex of the SHA-1 of document, character offset and symbol.
- symbol_id: Foreign key to dim_symbol: the symbol whose word occurs.
- x: Attribute: horizontal map coordinate from UMAP; unitless.
- y: Attribute: vertical map coordinate from UMAP; unitless.
- cluster_id: Attribute: HDBSCAN cluster number; -1 is noise. Numbered, never named.
- document_id: Foreign key to dim_symbolic_document: the book the occurrence is in.
- title: Attribute: title of the book.
- tradition: Attribute: tradition of the book.
- matched_term: Attribute: the word in the text that matched one of the symbol's aliases.
- context: Attribute: previous sentence, matching sentence and next sentence, each cut to a window.
- cluster_probability: Measure, non-additive: HDBSCAN membership probability for the cluster; 0-1.
- is_noise: Attribute: true when cluster_id is -1.

Tests: not_null on cluster_id; not_null on occurrence_id; not_null on x; not_null on y; relationships on symbol_id to symbols.symbol_id; unique on occurrence_id.

- cluster_id: Key: HDBSCAN cluster number; -1 is noise and is kept as a row.
- avg_cluster_probability: Measure, non-additive: mean HDBSCAN membership probability of those occurrences; 0-1.

Tests: not_null on occurrence_count; not_null on symbol_id; unique_combination of symbol_id, cluster_id.

- session: Foreign key to dim_parliament_session: riksmöte of the decision point, e.g. 2024/25.
- slug: Key: session folder name from the decision index path, e.g. 2024-25.
- file_order: Key: 1-based position of the decision in the indexes, files in path order then rows in file order.
- decision: Attribute: JSON decision object from the index, with point_id and the eight parties' positions and member vote counts added.

Tests: assert_every_indexed_decision_delivered; not_null on point_id; relationships on session to dim_parliament_session.session; unique on point_id; unique_combination of slug, file_order.
